_comment: Hand-maintained: domains that served malicious JavaScript to the sites loading scripts from them (a taken-over or sold CDN). A page loading any script from one of these, or from a subdomain, is reported. Every entry needs a report that names the domain as serving malicious code. Only script CDNs sites load code from are listed: the same reports also name the attackers' redirect and payload domains (unionadjs.com, xhsbpza.com …), which no site loads on purpose.
